items.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella highlights the alarming vulnerability of critical infrastructure to AI-powered cyberattacks, noting that much of it cannot be patched.

items.title: Is Coding with AI Actually Faster and Cheaper?
items.summary: This article explores the practical implications and effectiveness of using AI tools in software development, questioning if they truly deliver on promises of speed and cost reduction.

items.title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
items.summary: Google announces new features and broader availability for its Gemini AI, including support for lower-memory Android devices, expanding its reach and capabilities.

items.title: Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’
items.summary: Elon Musk publicly expresses strong support for NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, emphasizing his irreplaceable value to the AI industry amidst hypothetical scenarios.

items.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
items.summary: New research introduces a model capable of proactively speaking and acting in real-time streaming video environments, moving beyond simple question-answering to more interactive AI agents.

items.title: PROLA: Principal-Orthogonal Low-rank Adaptation for Predictive Spatiotemporal Weather Downscaling
items.summary: Researchers propose PROLA, a novel low-rank adaptation method, to improve the efficiency and accuracy of predictive spatiotemporal weather downscaling using AI models.

items.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
items.summary: This paper introduces VideoNexus, a new approach to video perception that allows AI models to understand and interpret video content beyond immediate reasoning contexts.

items.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
items.summary: A new paper introduces Jeveration, a system that enables 'System One' type AI models to generate content, potentially bridging intuitive and deliberative AI capabilities.

items.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
items.summary: This paper proposes the Resolution Hypothesis, suggesting that the evolution of AI agents is fundamentally driven by their ability to identify and implement improvements.

items.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
items.summary: Researchers present a method for scaling long-horizon coding agents by evolving training environments, enabling more complex and sustained AI-driven software development.

items.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
items.summary: ALIVE presents a new approach to make streaming video models interactive, allowing for real-time engagement and manipulation of video content by AI.

items.title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
items.summary: This research explores a co-development paradigm where AI agents and game environments evolve together to scale gameplay experiences for visual AI agents.

items.title: Retrieval Ran First. Was Its Result Actually Ready?
items.summary: This article discusses challenges in AI systems where retrieval components might execute prematurely, leading to suboptimal or incomplete results before the system is fully prepared.

items.title: WorldRuler: Interactive World Modeling under Configurable Rules
items.summary: WorldRuler introduces an interactive world modeling framework that allows AI systems to simulate and interact with environments based on user-configurable rules.

items.title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
items.summary: This research introduces FMT, a novel method for lossless image compression that operates efficiently in a fixed number of parallel steps, promising faster processing.
